theme: ceilings CE-7 goal_* dispatch row is IO
text: INTERPRETER (tree and VM, every sandbox kind): the runtime sandbox effect check for goal_run, goal_run_constrained, goal_run_categorical, goal_run_random, goal_run_multistart, goal_continue and goal_eval tests the row [IO] instead of the static [AI, Net, IO]. A goal_* call whose @[adaptive] metric makes no model call now runs (exit 0) under an AI-less sandbox where it exited 8; a metric that calls a model is still refused (exit 8) at its own ai_complete dispatch. Static reporting (axon caps, effect rows, E1310) and the audit kind are unchanged. Loosens a refusal only; no run that passed before changes outcome.
